subject: general
question: The greatest number which divides 52, 68 and 116 to leave the same remainder in each case is:
solution:
**Solution:**

HCF of (116 - 68) = 48, (68 - 52) = 16, and (116 - 52) = 64

HCF of 16, 48, 64 = 16

**∴ The greatest number is 16 which divides 52, 68 and 116 to leave the same remainder in each case.**
